svg.title: C15-M07-F2: Nonce strategy decision
svg.desc: Four situations mapped to nonce strategies: per-record keys with random nonces, rotation or extended or misuse-resistant modes for high volume, counters for a single writer, and deterministic nonces for signatures.
svg.text: per-record key (envelope)? -> random nonce, reuse practically impossible
shared key, high volume? -> rotate by count, or XChaCha20, or GCM-SIV
single writer, durable state? -> counter nonce (never restore/clone state)
Figure C15-M07-F2. Choosing a nonce strategy by design context.
